$comment: P69 (lane lm, D-FFI-INTTYPES-H-SHIPS-FOUR-FORMAT-MACROS): <inttypes.h> end to end on every pair. Every PRI width formats its own typedef through snprintf and the SCN macro of the same type reads it back with sscanf — 8/16/32/64-bit, LEAST, FAST, MAX and PTR, signed and unsigned, d/i/o/u/x/X — and imaxabs, imaxdiv, strtoimax, strtoumax, wcstoimax and wcstoumax run against the platform's own C library (glibc's C23 entry points __isoc23_strtoimax/strtoumax/wcstoimax/wcstoumax on ELF).
